dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: Before I set off for Natlan, I was warned that the nation has a hot climate, and I should dress light.

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: But who'd have thought it would be so hot over here at the People of the Springs that even my lightest dress is still not enough?

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh, it's fine. I've already pretty much solved the problem.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not going to buy new ones?

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: Of course I'll get them! And I'll get as many as I want.

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: I've already commissioned a swimsuit in the latest style, and I've bought some limited edition designer skateboards as well.

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: Given it's tailored, though, the swimsuit will take some time to make, so I've got to wait a while. It's fine, though — chilling here and listening to music isn't a bad way to pass the time.

dialogues.speaker: Baret
dialogues.text: Everything here from the people to the music are so laid-back and carefree. I think this suits me better than mainstream rock music.
